engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Issue with Fren Light Switch F47
stepByStepSolution: Verify correct Fren light bulbs are installed.
Inspect Fren light bulb sockets for damage.
technicalNotes:
On 1.9L TDI ALH engine, go into Engine then Measuring Blocks group 006, Field #2 (01-08-006#2)
Foot off Fren field #2 should read 000
Slowly press on Fren, should then read 011 with both "1" activating at the same time
If both "1" do not activate at same time, Fren Light Switch may be defective.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
